description: This Java source file defines the ResourceBundleMapWrapper class, which allows a ResourceBundle to be used as a Map with additional stack-based layering support and string expansion features.

classes.name: ResourceBundleMapWrapper
classes.description: A Map wrapper that uses a ResourceBundle as its data source, supporting layered resource bundles and string expansion.

classes.name: InternalRbmWrapper
classes.description: An internal class that wraps a ResourceBundle and provides Map interface methods for its keys and values.

methods.name: ResourceBundleMapWrapper

methods.name: addBottomResourceBundle
methods.description: Adds a ResourceBundle or InternalRbmWrapper to the bottom of the stack.

methods.name: pushResourceBundle
methods.description: Pushes a ResourceBundle onto the top of the stack.

methods.name: getInitialResourceBundle
methods.description: Returns the initial ResourceBundle used for the wrapper.
